label: Shelly Pro 1PM DIN-rail smart relay with LAN
description: Shelly Pro 1PM is a single-channel 16 A DIN-rail smart relay with power metering, over-temperature and over-voltage protection, a local web UI, MQTT and KNXnet/IP support. It has one RJ45 Ethernet port (100M) plus 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth for setup, but it is mains-fed from the DIN rail and is not PoE-powered, so the LAN cable is data only.
